d:
Rajdhani patna men janta dal yunaited (JDU) ke neta niraj kumar ne sushasan divas ke avsar par midiya se batchit karte hue parti ke rajnitik ejende aur nitish kumar ke netritv men hue samajik badlavon par apna bayan diya hai.
Jediyu neta niraj kumar ne kaha ki jab bihar ki janta ne nitish kumar ko prachand janadesh diya tha, tab patrakaron ne unse puchha tha ki unki prathmikta kya hai. niraj kumar ke anusar, us samay nitish kumar ne tin bar ek hi shabd bola tha— 'sushasan'. unhonne kaha ki bihar men sushasan ka ehsas aaj bihar ke aam aavam ko hai.
